body:
## P0 OWNER DIRECTIVE — native CI/CD integration handoff repair (2026-10-31)
Scope: independently diagnose and permanently repair the repository-native issue-agent → review PR → exact-head CI → governance → main integration continuation. This is a distinct blocker/remediation subtask of #649 and #650; do not mark either complete from issue creation.

### Exact evidence
- Issue #650 run https://github.com/ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt/actions/runs/41167846458, job 124439174680: steps 1–12 success; step 13 `Record review handoff and notify issue` failed (exit 2), `REVIEW_HANDOFF_BLOCKED ISSUE_COMMENT_READBACK_VERIFIED`.
- Persisted branch `issue-agent/650`, commit `43dad0ad1529cbc2fa14605d41b8bc5e6e25a2fd`, tree `a072dad3856e9a0250507f55a89b9a2be60d88b0`. The handoff receipt reportedly identifies `PR_CREATION_NOT_PERMITTED`; inspect exact receipt and HTTP response to distinguish GitHub Actions PR-creation setting, token permissions, and org policy. Do not infer which is causal without evidence.
- Artifact https://github.com/ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt/actions/runs/41167846458/artifacts/13029627392 (SHA256 f413abca20c05d78aa7f9b7128aef2be7f7d8f68663dfcacac49358f9fce4653).
- PR #648 native push-CI manifest mismatch; inspect deterministic regeneration and fail-closed repair path.

### Required implementation and acceptance
1. Persist machine-readable cause classification with HTTP status, permission diagnostics (never secret values), exact issue/branch/commit/tree, durable task state and retry provenance.
2. Within authorized GitHub settings and least-privilege token scope, fix PR creation. If owner/admin policy change is necessary, persist a precise owner-action gate; never bypass governance or claim autonomous resolution.
3. Event-driven continuation, no timers: on permission restoration or successor event, idempotently resume same issue branch, create/read back review PR, run exact-HEAD/TREE CI, verify TESTED_SUBJECT, apply existing governance, merge only when authorized, and read back main.
4. Detect and recover boundedly from manifest drift, stale claims, concurrency, cancelled jobs and retry exhaustion; persist failed and recovered states. New P0 work must not be starved by ongoing jobs. No infinite retry loops.
5. Test two competing issues (P0 priority), replay idempotency, PR-create permission denied and restored, manifest regeneration, failed CI, restart recovery, notification delivery and exact-head fixpoint.
6. Publish a human-readable GitHub Actions job summary with state diagram, gate status, evidence URLs and timestamps; all displayed progress from native readbacks, never fabricated percentages.
7. Effect acknowledgement only after independent actual effect readback; Host/TLS/Mesh/Zenodo remain separate gates.
8. Return exact run IDs, HEAD/TREE, artifacts, PR and main readback; explicitly distinguish implemented, CI-passed, merged and effective.

No external scheduler, no unapproved secret mutation, no unverified production claims.

### P0 admission replay (owner-authorized)
Priority label `P0` has been persisted. Re-evaluate native issue-agent admission and publish a run-bound receipt; do not claim stage-one green without successful live runner and priority readback. Preserve failures and continue through repository-native recovery gates.

### Native review handoff recovery event
PR #654 now exists for exact `issue-agent/651` HEAD `e038fad73bede0c86857778ad5edabae2995eb90`; native runner must independently read back and bind this PR rather than assume connector creation is a native success. Re-evaluate on this issue-edit event.

### Native retry after verified PR carrier
The existing PR #654 binds `issue-agent/651` at `e038fad73bede0c86857778ad5edabae2995eb90`. On this issue-edited event, the native handoff MUST read back that exact PR before any create attempt; success requires `REVIEW_HANDOFF_READY` in an independently reread receipt. Maintain P0 OPEN otherwise.

### Verified PR653 integration and bounded native continuation (2026-11-01)
AI-authored continuation under the existing Owner grant; this section grants no new permission. PR #653 was actually merged and independently read back at Main `6f59c86645a7783a281fb1d3d5c78dd8a2a30dca`, tree `cab56a4fd320ad3ae080df373a048cce8f979759`, ordered parents `[ee1f6f150cc479970793ae05a5ff2d48fa5821de, f6928de1aa308027e6fe66326f0b5eed1106a566]`. Candidate push/PR CI runs 41307596757/1 and 41307601030/1 succeeded with original TESTED_SUBJECT receipts bound to f6928de1/cab56a4f; the Main merge itself is a separate subject. Unchanged-input recovery now uses the existing handoff's `--readback-only` mode and cannot repeat PR/comment POSTs from a fresh output directory.

Continue this existing P0 work using the original issues:edited ingress and native processor at current Main. Preserve all preceding records and every acceptance criterion above. The current original branch/filtered PR readback binds existing PR #654 to `issue-agent/651` HEAD `96223e58da89f7fc27b5a0d5314e27d498ba52f7`; earlier e038fad7 statements are historical. Reobserve any successor head and exact matching PR after persistence. Read an ambiguous original effect before another write; never retry unchanged denied creation or invent an approval. Preserve native ADMISSION/HANDOFF originals with exact source/run/attempt/head/tree and independently verify their actual results. `UNSUPPORTED_DETERMINISTIC_WORK_UNIT`, draft/conflicting PR, missing current tests, missing governance or missing native effect readback keep this issue OPEN. Repository integration, handoff readiness, processing completion and productive EFFECT_ACK_DONE remain separate. No timer, external executor, secret or role change, publication or host acceptance is admitted by this update.
title: P0 BLOCKER: repair native issue-agent PR handoff and closed-loop DevOps continuation (#650)
